claim: For binary deterministic unit-cost sensing, a required structural gap q>=1 has componentwise first scope h*=min{h:2^h-1-h>=q}, n*=h*+q+1, m*=h*+q, and E*=h*+q minimal productive-frontier obligations.

interpretation: The feedback gain needed for a dynamical regime determines a required structural gap; binary information complexity then has an exact minimum corner. Mandatory obligations grow linearly with q while adaptive routing overhead grows only logarithmically.
scope: finite deterministic binary unit-cost sensing; local deterministic downstream dynamics when q is supplied by a phase threshold
novelty_boundary: No novelty claim for full-binary-tree counting, logarithmic scaling, or generic complex-eigenvalue criteria; the repository-specific result is the exact composition from dynamical gain requirement to structural gap to minimum finite information scope.
